variant_simulated: gf180mcuD (fleet image; sm141064.ngspice, sm141064.spice, design.ngspice byte-identical to gf180mcuC, checked by run.sh)

intact_range_ohm.status: assumption A4; only the 200 ohm point is documented (+/-30% is the assumed range)

programmed_range_ohm.status: assumption A5; only the 900 ohm point is documented (-30% is the assumed lower edge)

reference_ohm.status: assumption A6 (decision 0003); geometric midpoint of 200/900 is ~424 ohm

assumptions.A8_resistor_fs_sf_corner: the PDK model library declares resistor sections res_typical/res_ss/res_ff and no res_fs/res_sf, so the fs and sf corners keep the typical sheet rho; this has no documented source (new assumption, not in spec/efuse-otp.md); two of the five process corners therefore do not exercise the resistor corner dependence
assumptions.fuse_model: plain resistor of the stated value behind a series switch + select replica (nfet_06v0 4u / 60u, as in the reference leg); no bitline capacitance, no column-mux leakage

program_supply_v.status: assumption, held fixed; it only gates the 6 V select devices in this bench

assumptions.clock: one rising edge at 15n, amplitude tracks vdd33; sense_en held asserted
assumptions.not_simulated: reference tolerance and comparator offset (spec sense-margin row); no documented source for either; not varied by this bench's corners, see sim/sense-mc

definitions.margin_v: v(sbl) - v(sref) just before the clock edge
definitions.signed_margin_v: margin_v for programmed, -margin_v for intact; positive = correct side of the reference
definitions.decision_bit: 1 if v(sense_out) >= 0.7 vdd33, 0 if <= 0.3 vdd33, else null

negative_control.description: reference moved from 400 to 200 ohm (inside the intact range); an intact fuse above it must read the wrong side

verdict: data only; see fuses[*].all_margin_positive / all_decisions_ok. analog margin positive at every point: True; comparator decision correct and resolved at every point: True; negative control flips sign: True

physical_reference.description: the same fuse values against the committed XRref (ppolyf_u device, including its terminal resistance and its corner dependence; fs/sf keep the typical sheet rho, A8), not the ideal stand-in
